text:
maria: quick heads-up — I ran a grep across the docs site and found several examples still calling the /v1 models endpoint. flagged in the migration checklist :eyes:
ken: ugh, thanks. which folders did you find them in?
maria: mostly under /guides/migration and /recipes/chatbot, plus a couple in snippets that call the old SDK `Client.generate()` API.
sam: I can patch those today. will PR to update to /v2 and the new `responses.create` pattern. assigning to myself — @sam :thumbsup:
jules: when you swap snippets, also add a tiny note about model fallback semantics when migrating from redwood-v1 -> redwood-v2. some users expect identical logits ordering.
maria: good call. also we should add a redirect for the old v1 examples so external links don't 404.
ken: redirects are owned by the docs-redirects team. @deploy-bot can you open a ticket for this?
deploy-bot: created DOCS-1427: "redirects for deprecated /v1 examples" with labels: redirects, urgent. ETA triage tomorrow.
sam: opened PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/768 — updates snippets, replaces SDK calls, and adds migration note. PTAL @ken @jules
jules: skimmed — looks good. please add one-liner about streaming framing changes and an example of incremental read to avoid surprises.
sam: adding the streaming snippet now, will push an update to the PR.
maria: can we get this in the next docs deploy (tomorrow morning)? :pray:
ken: once PR is approved I'll queue for the deploy. if redirects are urgent we can request an out-of-band patch.
sam: pushed an update with streaming example. thanks — will ping when CI passes.
jules: nice, LGTM pending CI.
maria: awesome, thanks team — filing a quick follow-up to audit other repos (snippets library, examples-app) for any stray v1 calls.
ken: good plan. leave a checklist in DOCS-1427 and tag me if you find anything else.
